description:
Export the 'ne:ne_countries' layer from GeoServer's WFS service in four different output formats, filtered to include ONLY countries where the 'continent' attribute is 'South America'.

You must generate the following four files in the directory '~/exports/':
1. 'south_america.geojson' (Format: GeoJSON)
2. 'south_america.kml' (Format: KML)
3. 'south_america.gml' (Format: GML3)
4. 'south_america.csv' (Format: CSV)

Use the WFS endpoint (e.g., http://localhost:8080/geoserver/wfs) to construct your requests. You may use the browser (Firefox) or command line tools (curl/wget) to download the data.
